# pymobiledevice3

> Pure Python 3 implementation for working with iOS devices (iPhone, iPad, ...)

Pure Python 3 implementation for working with iOS devices (iPhone, iPad, ...); ships a CLI and a Python API.

## Getting started

- [Home](https://doronz88.github.io/pymobiledevice3/latest/index.md)
- [Installation](https://doronz88.github.io/pymobiledevice3/latest/installation/index.md)
